integrity: Established generalized-dephasing capacity and classical total-variation results are credited. The newly assessed claim is the parity-periodic channel capacity relaxation profile and first-crossing law. Priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Only the Haar-coin-averaged vertex channel on the Boolean hypercube is covered; not individual random-coin realizations or the joint coin-vertex channel.
The unassisted quantum capacity is computed per independent use of the full composed map, not per elementary step.
The sharp asymptotic profile applies to fixed scaled time c, with no uniform-error theorem over growing c.
The classical 1990 comparison manuscript was not examined in full; an implicit prior deduction of the entropy constant remains possible.
Finite numerical checks are corroborative and no independent review has been performed.
title: Sharp quantum-capacity window for the averaged Haar-coin hypercube walk
